messages.content: You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I create a Nimbus account?
Head to the Nimbus sign-up page, enter your work email, and confirm the verification message. Once verified, you can create your first workspace and start exploring.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is a Nimbus workspace?
A workspace is where your projects, datasets, models, and team members live. It also controls billing and permissions for everything inside it.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I invite team members?
Open Workspace Settings → Members → Invite, enter their email, and pick a role: Viewer, Editor, Admin, or Owner. They will receive an invitation link.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I enforce MFA for my workspace?
Yes. Workspace admins can require TOTP-based multi-factor authentication for every member under Security settings.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What plans does Nimbus offer?
Nimbus has Free, Pro at $49 per user per month, Team at $99 per user per month, and Enterprise with custom pricing.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I upgrade my plan?
Go to Workspace Settings → Billing → Change Plan. Upgrades apply immediately and you are charged the prorated difference.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Will I lose data if I downgrade?
No, your existing data stays safe. However, you may not be able to create new resources that exceed the lower plan limits.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I set a spending cap?
Yes. Team and Enterprise plans can set monthly spending alerts and hard caps in Billing → Budgets.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I generate an API key?
Visit Workspace Settings → API Keys → Create Key. Choose scopes and an expiration date, then store the key securely.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I install the Python SDK?
Run pip install nimbus-cloud inside a Python 3.9 or newer environment. Then import nimbus and authenticate with your API key.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I authenticate API requests?
Pass your API key in the Authorization header as Bearer YOUR_API_KEY on every request to https://api.nimbuscloud.example.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is the API rate limit?
Limits depend on your plan: Free 10 per minute, Pro 300 per minute, Team 1,000 per minute, and Enterprise custom limits.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Is data encrypted at rest?
Yes. All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256, and encryption keys are managed in hardware security modules.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Does Nimbus sign BAA for HIPAA?
Yes. Enterprise customers can sign a Business Associate Agreement for HIPAA-eligible workloads.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Does Nimbus train on customer data?
No. Nimbus does not use your data to train foundation models unless you explicitly opt in.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I report a security issue?
Email security@nimbuscloud.example with the details. We run a responsible disclosure program and appreciate reports.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I start a training job?
Upload your dataset, choose a base model, and click Start Training in the Models section, or call POST /v1/training-jobs from the API.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is the difference between fine-tuning and RAG?
Fine-tuning changes model behavior by updating weights, while RAG retrieves relevant documents to ground answers without modifying the model.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is LoRA?
LoRA is Low-Rank Adaptation, a parameter-efficient way to fine-tune models by training small adapter layers instead of every weight.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I deploy a model to production?
After training or importing a model, click Deploy, pick an instance type, and configure autoscaling rules.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
My API key is not working. What should I check?
Check that the key is active, has the right scope, has not expired, and is sent as Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Why are my generated answers hallucinating?
Hallucinations usually mean missing or irrelevant context. Add RAG, lower the temperature, and use a clear system prompt.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
My model responses are too slow. How do I improve latency?
Try a smaller model, enable quantization, deploy closer to your users, or add response caching.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Why is my training job failing?
Common reasons include malformed JSONL, mismatched message roles, too few training examples, or an invalid base model ID.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How can I sign up?
Go to the Nimbus sign-up page, enter your work email, and click the verification link in your inbox. Then create your workspace.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Tell me about Nimbus pricing.
Nimbus offers Free, Pro at $49 per user per month, Team at $99 per user per month, and custom Enterprise pricing.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Do you have a Python package?
Yes. Install it with pip install nimbus-cloud. It requires Python 3.9 or newer and wraps the Nimbus REST API.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Is my information secure with Nimbus?
Yes. Nimbus encrypts data at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher, and holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What should I do if I hit a rate limit?
A 429 error means you hit your plan limit. Wait a moment, add retries with exponential backoff, or upgrade your plan for higher limits.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I deploy my own model?
Yes. You can import ONNX, safetensors, GGUF, or PyTorch checkpoints, then deploy them just like Nimbus-hosted models.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I monitor what my team is doing?
Admins and Owners can review the Audit Log under Security to see model invocations, deployment changes, and authentication events.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What file types can I upload?
Nimbus accepts CSV, Parquet, JSONL, and TXT files. Make sure they are UTF-8 encoded.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Explain chunk overlap in RAG.
Chunk overlap is the number of shared tokens between neighboring text chunks. It keeps context intact where ideas cross chunk boundaries.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I pick a temperature?
Use 0.1 to 0.3 for factual answers and 0.7 to 0.9 for creative tasks. Lower values produce more deterministic output.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I run batch inference?
Yes. Use POST /v1/batch-jobs with an input file and output destination. You will be notified when the job completes.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What regions can I deploy in?
Nimbus serves models in us-east-1, eu-west-1, and ap-southeast-1. Enterprise customers can add private regions.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
I forgot my password.
No problem. Click Forgot password on the login page and follow the instructions in the email. Enterprise users may need to reset through SSO.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I leave feedback?
Use the in-app chat or email support@nimbuscloud.example. We read every message and use it to improve the platform.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How can I get an invoice?
Invoices are emailed to your billing contact and available for download under Billing → Invoices.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Do you support Google SSO?
Yes. Enterprise plans support Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and other SAML 2.0 / OIDC providers.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is model drift?
Model drift happens when real-world data changes and the model's predictions become less accurate over time. Nimbus tracks this in the Observability dashboard.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I run A/B tests?
Yes. Deployments support traffic splitting across model versions, which you can use for A/B testing and canary releases.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I rotate my API key?
Create a new key with the needed scopes, update your applications, then revoke the old key from Workspace Settings → API Keys.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I stream completions?
Yes. Set stream to true in your chat completion request to receive Server-Sent Events as the model generates tokens.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I check API health?
Send a GET request to https://api.nimbuscloud.example/v1/health. A 200 response means the API is available.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is a batch job?
A batch job processes a large input file asynchronously and writes results to your chosen destination. It is ideal for offline inference.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I restrict data egress?
Yes. Enterprise plans can configure egress controls and approved destination allowlists.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I delete a dataset?
Send DELETE /v1/datasets/{dataset_id}. This permanently removes the dataset and its associated embeddings.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is auto-scaling?
Auto-scaling adjusts the number of inference replicas based on traffic and latency targets so you only pay for what you need.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I get started quickly?
Create a workspace, upload a CSV dataset, pick a model, and run a batch job or build a small Streamlit app with the Python SDK.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is the status page?
The status page is https://status.nimbuscloud.example. It tracks API, dashboard, and model serving availability.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I change my workspace slug?
Only Owners can change the workspace slug from Workspace Settings → General. Changing it may break existing API references.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I export model weights?
Yes. Owners can export fine-tuned model weights in safetensors or GGUF format from the model details page.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is the difference between batch and real-time inference?
Real-time inference returns responses synchronously for low latency. Batch inference processes files asynchronously for large volumes.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I set a system prompt?
Open your deployment settings and enter a system prompt, or include a system message in your API request.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I pause a deployment?
Yes. You can pause a deployment from the deployment dashboard. Pausing stops billing for inference replicas.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is model versioning?
Every trained or imported model receives a version ID. You can pin deployments to specific versions and roll back if needed.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I add custom metrics?
Enterprise customers can publish custom metrics through the Observability API and visualize them on custom dashboards.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I use Nimbus on-premise?
Enterprise plans offer private deployment options including VPC peering, private endpoints, and air-gapped installs.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I estimate training cost?
The training form shows an estimated cost based on base model, dataset size, and epochs before you start the job.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is quantization?
Quantization reduces the numerical precision of model weights to shrink size and speed up inference. Nimbus supports INT8 and GPTQ.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I contact sales?
Email sales@nimbuscloud.example or book a demo through the pricing page. Enterprise prospects also get a 30-day trial.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I import my own embedding model?
Yes. Enterprise plans let you import custom embedding and reranking models for RAG pipelines.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I handle PII in training data?
Remove or mask PII before uploading. Nimbus provides optional data scanners that flag sensitive content.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is a prompt template?
A prompt template is a reusable prompt structure with placeholders for user input and retrieved context.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I enable audit logging?
Audit logging is enabled by default. Admins can export logs from Security → Audit Log as CSV or JSON.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I share a project publicly?
Public sharing is available on Team and Enterprise plans. Generate a public link with read-only access from Project Settings.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I set up alerts?
Go to Observability → Alerts and create rules based on latency, error rate, cost, or custom metrics.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is a reranker?
A reranker scores retrieved chunks against the query and reorders them so the most relevant context appears first.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I get support as a free user?
Free users can access community support through the Help Center and public forums.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I use Nimbus from a Jupyter notebook?
Yes. The Python SDK works inside Jupyter notebooks. You can upload data, start jobs, and query deployments from cells.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I add metadata to documents for filtering?
Include a metadata dictionary when uploading documents. You can then filter retrieval by category, date, or any custom field.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What happens when my trial ends?
When the trial ends, your workspace downgrades to the selected plan. You can upgrade before expiration to avoid interruptions.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I evaluate a RAG pipeline?
Evaluate retrieval with hit rate and MRR, and evaluate answers with faithfulness, relevance, and human review.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I schedule retraining?
Yes. Enterprise plans support scheduled jobs that retrain models when new data arrives or on a cron schedule.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I connect Nimbus to my data warehouse?
Use the Nimbus data connector for Snowflake, BigQuery, or Postgres, or export snapshots to S3 and import them as datasets.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is few-shot prompting?
Few-shot prompting gives the model example input-output pairs in the prompt to guide its response style without training.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I know if my model is overfitting?
Overfitting appears when training loss keeps dropping but validation loss rises. Use early stopping and a validation split.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I use Nimbus for image generation?
Currently Nimbus focuses on text and embedding models. Image generation is on the 2026 roadmap.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is an inference endpoint?
An inference endpoint is a URL backed by a deployed model. You send prompts to it and receive generated responses.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I back up my workspace data?
Admins and Owners can schedule daily exports to S3 or GCS from Workspace Settings → Backups.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I fine-tune on CPU only?
Small LoRA jobs can run on CPU but are much slower. For practical iteration, use Apple Silicon, CUDA, or cloud GPUs.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I interpret validation loss?
Lower validation loss generally means better generalization. If it starts rising while training loss falls, your model is overfitting.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is the difference between embeddings and tokens?
Tokens are pieces of text the model reads. Embeddings are numerical vector representations of text used for similarity search.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I use my own LLM with Nimbus RAG?
Yes. You can point the RAG generator to any Ollama model or Nimbus-hosted endpoint that you have access to.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I add a webhook?
Go to Workspace Settings → Webhooks → Add Endpoint. Choose the event types and provide a URL that can accept POST requests.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is the difference between a model and a deployment?
A model is the trained artifact. A deployment is a running instance that serves that model behind an endpoint.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I get an API health check?
Send GET https://api.nimbuscloud.example/v1/health. A 200 OK means the API is up.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is the Nimbus CLI?
The Nimbus CLI is a command-line tool for managing projects, deployments, and datasets. Install it with pip install nimbus-cli.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I use environment variables for API keys?
Yes. Set NIMBUS_API_KEY in your environment and the SDK will read it automatically.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I switch regions?
You can deploy new resources in a different region, but existing data residency cannot be moved automatically. Contact support for migrations.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is a base model?
A base model is the pretrained model you start from before fine-tuning or using in a RAG pipeline.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I delete a training job?
You can cancel a running job, but completed jobs remain in the job history for auditing and reproducibility.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I version control my prompts?
Store prompt templates in your Git repository and deploy them through the API or CLI with version tags.

What is the best embedding model for English support docs?
nomic-embed-text and all-MiniLM-L6-v2 are both strong free choices for English support documentation retrieval.

How do I handle duplicate questions in the FAQ?
Consolidate duplicates into a single canonical question-answer pair and redirect aliases to it in your retrieval metadata.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I limit who can start training jobs?
Yes. Workspace Owners and Admins can restrict training job creation to specific roles in Workspace Settings → Permissions.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I view model logs?
Open the deployment details page and select Logs. You can filter by time range, severity, and request ID.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
What is a cold start?
A cold start happens when a scaled-to-zero deployment receives its first request and must spin up an inference replica.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
How do I request a new feature?
Submit a feature request through the Help Center or email feedback@nimbuscloud.example. Enterprise customers can share requests directly with their CSM.
You are a helpful Nimbus Cloud Solutions support assistant. Answer briefly, accurately, and in a friendly tone.
Can I run Nimbus in my own VPC?
Yes. Enterprise plans support private deployments with VPC peering and dedicated infrastructure.
